name: Grilled chicken
summary: Grilled chicken with cơm lam toward Langbiang or in Cu Lan, and on the chicken menu at 7 Tô Hiến Thành.
origin: Gà nướng toward Langbiang or in Cu Lan, and at Lẩu Gà Số 7.
howToEat: With cơm lam it sits beside forest meat and grilled eggs. At Số 7 it is one of the chicken plates, with boiled chicken, chicken steamed with fish sauce, and a hotpot.
where: Toward Langbiang, or Cu Lan village. Lẩu Gà Số 7, 7 Tô Hiến Thành, open 10:00–22:00.
priceBand: A price for the grilled chicken alone is Check on arrival. Số 7 prints 50,000–200,000 VND for the door, not per plate. The village plate has no price.
